pivapplet.preprocess: ant preprocess with repo-bundled JPP at build.xml defaults

yubico-piv-tool.provisioning: change-pin/change-puk/generate/verify-pin/selfsign-certificate/import-certificate with --stdin-input plus -i/-o file IO, ATR-pinned exact reader; per-stage native success markers plus certificate file bounds asserted

features.daemon: pcscd plus the jcardsim JVM supervised per operation in foreground; Linux subreaper, state/control leases, pcscd socket plus vpcd-slots plus reader-with-card plus ATR-match plus native census readiness, bounded shutdown
features.native_uid: caller root or non-root, any primary group; no NSS wrapper

reproducibility: Frozen source/package/build input identity; offline compilation. The emulator card is RAM-only: every operation provisions a fresh card and no card state persists; byte-identical image rebuilding not asserted.
